data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month; each of the other 24 may opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Assuming k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but lowers remaining stock8 and the low-recovery stock16. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed; intentions aren't enforced. Other catches require recalculation.
